items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: George Butler added two or three pieces on it

ctx.x: That was in 1967. Which I have to say, personally, is one or my 2 or 3 favorites of yours.
That’s a beautiful record. A couple of records I made myself, and then George Butler added two or three pieces on it, but it wasn’t really me.
Would those be the early ‘70s things on Blue Note...
